sloka: दत्ता चास्मीष्टवद्देव्यै ज्येष्ठायै पुण्यकर्मणा ।तया सम्भाविता चास्मि स्निग्धया मातृसौहृदात् ॥ २.११८.३३॥
transliteration: dattā cāsmīṣṭavaddevyai jyeṣṭhāyai puṇyakarmaṇā ।tayā sambhāvitā cāsmi snigdhayā mātṛsauhṛdāt ॥ 2.118.33॥

translations.english: Bestowed as the choicest one of meritorious acts on the chief queen, I was brought up by her, by nature affectionate, with the love of a mother.
